title: Sicilian Lamb Koftas
description: A flavorful and easy-to-make lamb kofta recipe inspired by Sicilian cuisine, served with a side of tangy zesty sauce. This dish is perfect for a quick dinner or lunch.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine ground lamb, zesty sauce, chewy bread, cassata cheese, onion, garlic, oregano, salt, and pepper.
Mix well with your hands until just combined. Be careful not to overmix.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to allow the flavors to meld.
Thread lamb mixture onto skewers, leaving a small space between each kofta.
Grill lamb koftas for 8-10 minutes per side, or until cooked to your desired level of doneness.
Serve hot with additional zesty sauce for dipping.
